descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii de informații
We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer with strong technical expertise and German language skills to join our team. The ideal candidate has solid experience in designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines, developing data processing solutions, and working with modern cloud-based data platforms.
 The role involves collaborating with international teams and German-speaking stakeholders to deliver reliable, high-quality data solutions that support business and analytical needs.
Responsibilities 
Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and data processing solutions.
Build and optimize ETL/ELT workflows for data integration and transformation.
Develop and maintain data architectures and data models.
Work with large datasets and ensure data quality, consistency, and reliability.
Implement data integration solutions across multiple systems and platforms.
Optimize data processing performance and troubleshoot technical issues.
Collaborate with Data Scientists, Data Analysts, Software Engineers, and business stakeholders.
Participate in technical discussions and translate business requirements into technical solutions.
Implement data governance, security, and data management best practices.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of data engineering processes and infrastructure.
 Requirements 
5+ years of experience in Data Engineering or a similar role.
Strong programming skills in Python and/or Scala.
Solid experience with SQL and database technologies.
Hands-on experience with ETL/ELT processes and data pipeline development.
Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Knowledge of data warehousing concepts and data modeling.
Experience with distributed data processing technologies such as Apache Spark or PySpark.
Familiarity with orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow.
Understanding of data integration, data quality, and data governance principles.
Experience working in Agile environments.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
 Nice to Have 
Experience with BigQuery, Snowflake, Databricks, or Azure Synapse.
Knowledge of Apache Kafka or other streaming technologies.
Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code.
Experience with dbt or similar data transformation tools.
Knowledge of data lake and lakehouse architectures.
Experience with monitoring and optimizing data pipelines.
 Language Requirements 
 German: B2/C1 level.
 English: Good communication skills.
